_comment: Spirits (2026-11-13, integrator D), Usher's boast {1}{W} paid by Secluded Courtyard's {W}: the Courtyard's coloured mana may pay an ability of a creature (colored_creature_ability_ok), Unclaimed Territory's only creature SPELLS (it pays the {1} as {C}). Board: Usher 2/1 + Secluded Courtyard + Unclaimed Territory, filler Unclaimed Territory (the Courtyard is the ONLY {W} that can pay the boast, so one boast a turn).
